text:
maya: heads-up, main is failing CI on the latest merge from @sam, mypy + pre-commit both red :frowning:
ci-bot: Pipeline #4821 failed on job `unit-tests` and `pre-commit`. Logs: https://ci.redwood/4821
sam: ugh, saw the alert. i'm looking — probably my change to utils/typing.py
lucas: quick glance at the logs shows pyright complaining about `Config` shape and mypy about `Optional[Mapping]` in `cache.py`
anya: can someone paste the exact errors? logs are noisy for me rn
maya: pyright: `Type 'None' is not assignable to type 'Mapping[str, Any]'` at utils/config.py:42
maya: mypy: `error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "None", variable has type "Mapping[str, Any]")` at infra/cache.py:88
sam: ok that matches my local repro. I changed default from {} to None to avoid shared mutable default — but forgot to update return type hints
lucas: that explains it. Pre-commit also failing because black/ruff reformatted a file — conflict with upstream style.
maya: can we rerun CI after a quick patch? i can't push right now, will be in 30m
sam: i can open a hotfix PR. quick fix: make return type Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] and add a guard in function body. patch:

```py
def load_config(...) -> Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    cfg = None
    if raw:
        cfg = parse(raw)
    return cfg
```

sam: will also run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally before pushing
anya: small ask — do a pyright run too: `pnpm dlx pyright --lib es2020` (we have config overrides)
maya: thanks @sam. if someone can bisect to confirm which commit introduced the black/ruff diff, that'd be helpful — I think it's from the PR that landed just before this one
lucas: i can bisect after lunch. steps in case others want to try:
- git checkout main
- git bisect start HEAD -- $(git rev-list --first-parent --max-count=20 HEAD)
- git bisect bad
- git bisect good <commit-ish>

lucas: note: pre-commit failures are usually from formatting so you can run `pre-commit run --hook-stage commit` on suspected commits
sam: pushing hotfix PR now, will include tests and updated type hints
ci-bot: Re-run requested by sam. New pipeline #4822 queued.
maya: :thumbsup: once CI green we can merge. if pyright still complains we should add a short migration note in the PR
anya: if bisect finds the formatting change, we can add a ruff config override for that file to avoid churn
sam: PR link: https://git.redwood/pulls/1298 — contains fix + pre-commit run
maya: pinging for review from @anya and @lucas, small patch
lucas: reviewing now, focusing on typing changes only, will comment inline
anya: quick review passed, left 1 nit about a docstring. lgtm after that
maya: CI passed on #4822 — all green. merging in 5
sam: merged. thanks everyone :tada:
lucas: will follow up on bisect for the formatting change and open a separate PR if needed
maya: closing the loop here — post-merge note in #eng-releases about the typing change and recommended local checks
ci-bot: Build #4822 succeeded.
